property_summary: For every caller context where proxiableUUID is called on the implementation contract (not via delegatecall), the reference returns the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant; the mutant returning ADMIN_SLOT will sometimes return a different bytes32 value, so the returned slot must equal ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT for all inputs — the mutant violates this for inputs where caller is not delegated.
change_summary: Change proxiableUUID to return a different storage slot constant (replace IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT with ADMIN_SLOT).
